items.title: File Einspruch against tax assessment
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 27.12.2024. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (as it stood before the 2025 postal-law change, and as the letter itself states: 'am dritten Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post'), the letter counts as delivered on the 3rd day after posting, i.e. Mon 30.12.2024. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO the one-month period starts the next day. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. Thu 30.01.2025. That day is a working day (no NW public holiday), so no shift is needed under § 108 Abs. 3 AO. Final day: 30.01.2025.

items.title: Annual motor vehicle tax collected by direct debit
items.quote: Die Steuer wird jährlich im Voraus durch Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: The tax of €186.00 per year is set to start 01.01.2025 and is collected automatically by direct debit ('im Voraus', i.e. in advance for the year). The letter does not print a specific calendar date for the debit, only that it happens yearly in advance from the start of the new tax period (01.01.2025). No exact debit date can be determined from the text.
